summary: Stretches a texture row horizontally by replicating each source pixel a number of times into an output row buffer (a2). The stretch factor is the stride-table entry dword_5AFABC[a3]; the stretched width is that factor times the source width (this+0x0). The bits-per-pixel byte (this+0xB) selects the packing path: 1, 2, or 4-bit values are read from the packed source bitstream and written with bit-level mask-clear/insert into the output bitstream, while any value >= 8 uses a byte-copy path (bytes per pixel = this+0xB >> 3). On completion this+0x0 is updated to the stretched width and this+0x4 to the output byte count ((stretched width * this+0xB + 7) >> 3). Returns void.

operations.description: Guard: return without work when the output buffer a2 or the info pointer a1 is null.
Compute target width as dword_5AFABC[a3] * source width (this+0x0); the same table entry is retained as the per-pixel stretch factor.
Guard: bits-per-pixel byte (this+0xB) == 1 selects the single-bit replication path.

1bpp path: for each of the source-width pixels (this+0x0), read one bit from the packed source bitstream and, in an inner loop, write that bit (mask-clear then insert) the stretch-factor number of times into the output bitstream.
Guard: bits-per-pixel byte (this+0xB) == 2 selects the 2-bit replication path.
2bpp path: for each source pixel, read a 2-bit value and replicate it the stretch-factor number of times at 2-bit alignment in the output bitstream.
Guard: bits-per-pixel byte (this+0xB) == 4 selects the 4-bit replication path.
4bpp path: for each source pixel, read a 4-bit value and replicate it the stretch-factor number of times at 4-bit alignment in the output bitstream.
Guard: else path for bits-per-pixel >= 8, where bytes per pixel = this+0xB >> 3.

Byte path: copy each source row chunk (bytes per pixel times source width) into a local buffer and copy that buffer the stretch-factor number of times into the output row, iterating source-width times.
Finalize: update this+0x0 to the stretched width and this+0x4 to the output byte count (stretched width * this+0xB + 7) >> 3.
Function returns void; no value is produced.
